answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 49806 Country: India Title: dua for my son's good behavier Question: My son is Hafiz-e-Quran. He completed at the age of 11years. Now he became rebel, he doesn't want to wear topi, jhubba. He screams on us (parents) and uses foul language. We are very much worried about him and his behavior. What is the dua we need to read? How will he change? We want to join him alim course but he doen't want to do it? We can't force him to do alim because he is even ready to listen even small thing we say to him. Please remember him in your duas, and let us know what we have to do and what dua we need to read? Answer ID: 49806 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 195/163/B=02/1435) Recite this (وجدک ضالاً فھدی) 40 times and blow on water and give the water to your son to drink. Also supplicate for him after five obligatory salah every day and read this dua as well: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
